This page is a build check (Step 3.2). It mounts the pipeline widget from `../../js/`.

```{=html}
<div id="w-smoke" class="dpx-host"></div>
<script src="../../js/vendor/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="../../js/vendor/plot.min.js"></script>
<script src="../../js/bundles/smoke-pmf.js"></script>
<script>
  window.__dpxSmoke = DPX["smoke-pmf"].mountWidget(document.getElementById("w-smoke"), { a: 1.6, b: 1.22, J: 50 });
</script>
```
